name: Dave Carelli
source: Dave is an old friend of Aiden's from their college days. They were the type to go to frat parties or hang out on the weekend. Dave is also on the force, though in a higher position than Aiden, they often work together to solve complicated cases. Not to mention, Dave would do anything for an old friend. But! Don't let him catch you alone--he's a bit of a narc and enjoys frivolities such as a late night with a willing partner.
